reference: GNU coreutils sha256sum from the runner's read-only /usr tree is the parity oracle; each case runs the same script under reference Bash with GNU sha256sum on PATH and under bash-os with PATH empty.
coverage: -c summary lines, --status and --ignore-missing, and usage diagnostics (guest pass 7).
exclusions: Digest output itself is covered by suites/sha256sum.json and the cksum suites.

cases.purpose: sha256sum -c prints GNU's summary lines: "WARNING: 1 line is improperly formatted" and its plural, read and mismatch counts, "no properly formatted checksum lines found" even under --status, "no file was verified" after the warnings, --ignore-missing silencing only missing files; usage errors use GNU's wording and the Try line (guest pass 7, G105).
cases.script:
s() { local rc=0; eval "$1" 2>&1 || rc=$?; echo "rc=$rc"; }
echo 1 > a; echo 2 > b; sha256sum a b > s; cp s s2; echo junk >> s; echo junk >> s2; echo junk2 >> s2; echo junk > s7; sha256sum a | sed 's/ a$/ a5/' > s5; cp s5 s5j; echo junk >> s5j; sha256sum a | sed 's/^./x/' > bad; echo junk >> bad
s 'sha256sum -c s'
s 'sha256sum -c s2'
s 'sha256sum -c -w s'
s 'sha256sum -c s7'
s 'sha256sum -c --status s7'
s 'sha256sum -c -w s7'
s 'sha256sum -c --status nosuch'
s 'sha256sum -c --status s5'
s 'sha256sum -c --ignore-missing s5j'
s 'sha256sum -c --status --ignore-missing s5'
s 'sha256sum -c --quiet s'
s 'sha256sum -c --status --quiet bad'
s 'sha256sum -c --quiet --status bad'
s 'sha256sum -c --status --warn bad'
s 'sha256sum --bogus'
s 'sha256sum -Q'
s 'sha256sum --quiet a'
s 'sha256sum --status --warn a'
s 'sha256sum --ignore-missing --quiet a'
s 'sha256sum -c --tag a'
s 'sha256sum -c --tag -z a'
